opening.argument: The presentation examines Forsage by tracing how its payment structure operates and by testing the claims made around participation. It explains that commissions depend on buying additional slots: "If you buy new slots then you will get commission from that slot and money is also available. If you do not buy a new slot then you will not get money." It further identifies recruitment, rather than a genuine product, as the claimed revenue source, while describing compensation as funded by contributions from new investors. The speaker therefore treats Forsage as a structure requiring scrutiny, not as an opportunity to promote, and ends with a direct warning: "do not invest in ProSage."
